answer: Per-answer melt-and-latch ledger.** Each task answer hashes its prior ledger tip plus a hardware-derived ferrous key, so a copied answer fails to latch and cannot be resubmitted. The anchor for identity is that unique latch event, recorded once and never reusable across keys. At the network's nadir of low activity, replay attempts still cost a fresh key-generation and latch cycle per identity, forcing attackers to pay full compute per attempt rather than amortize one answer across many.
